sn34.10:1.4: idha bhikkhave ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ sappāyakārī.
sn34.10:1.5: idha pana bhikkhave ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ sappāyakārī hoti na samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo.
sn34.10:1.6: idha pana bhikkhave ekacco jhāyī neva samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ sappāyakārī.
sn34.10:1.7: idha pana bhikkhave ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo ca hoti samādhismiṃ sappāyakārī ca.
sn34.10:1.8: tatra bhikkhave yvāyaṃ jhāyī samādhismiṃ samādhikusalo ca samādhismiṃ sappāyakārī ca. ayaṃ imesaṃ catunnaṃ jhāyīnaṃ aggo ca seṭṭho ca pāmokkho ca uttamo ca pavaro ca.
